services.name: cloudbrowser-postgres
post_migration_checks: create least-privilege cloudbrowser_api_login role using approved secret
verify private lookup function EXECUTE permissions

work_items_before_activation: Confirm staged source SHA matches the GitHub branch and release gates
Verify database POSTGRES_* and PGDATA are valid and dedicated to staging
Set staging-only DATABASE_URL to least-privileged application role; never use database owner/superuser for API
Verify API ENGINE_URL private DNS and matching engine key reference without copying production secrets
Apply portable schema migrations to staging with evidence, then test least-privilege access
Do not enable worker, queue consumer, public CDP, direct engine domain or cron
Obtain target-specific budget/paid deployment approval before applying the staged patch
mandatory_acceptance: CI lockfiles/build/security/RLS negative tests against exact SHA
Staging DB migration version and RLS negative checks under application role
Authorized create/execute/screenshot/delete session with synthetic account
SSRF denies localhost, metadata IP, IPv6 private networks and DNS redirects
Timeout, concurrency, teardown and rollback procedures
Distinct independent Guardian receipt at deployed SHA
known_blockers_as_of_2026_10_21: Railway staging patch uncommitted: 37 changes; services and volume not deployed
Staged API variable list does not include DATABASE_URL
Staging database migrations and least-privilege API login role not validated
Deployment approval and distinct Guardian receipt absent
